'''Jadam Questrel''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was an official representative of the [[Corellian Shipbuilders Union]] in [[Doaba Guerfel/Legends|Doaba Guerfel]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He resided on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] in the city and could often be found at the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] there.
